hero.title: DVA Volleyball Club Try-Out Program
hero.subtitle: Join Hanoi's premier indoor volleyball community. Register for an official on-court skill evaluation with DVA Coaching Staff across our Senior, Junior, and Youth squads.
hero.groupRuleTitle: Evaluation sessions open when 5+ athletes register
hero.groupRuleDesc: Once a weekly time slot reaches 5 or more registered candidates, our Coaching Staff confirms the session and sends your official invitation email with venue access instructions.
hero.venueChip: 155 Truong Chinh Arena, Thanh Xuan, Hanoi

schedule.eveningNote: 60-minute assessment on Taraflex court before regular squad play. Please arrive by 17:45 for warm-up.
schedule.sundayNote: 60-minute weekend evaluation session. Please arrive by 13:15 for check-in and dynamic stretching.
schedule.venueName: BTL Thong Tin Indoor Sports Hall
schedule.venueStandards: 7.5mm Taraflex flooring · Clean non-marking indoor volleyball shoes required · Official Mikasa V200W balls provided.

criteria.sectionSubtitle: All candidates are evaluated holistically across four core performance pillars during the 60-minute session.

items.title: Physical & Vertical Jump
items.subtitle: Explosiveness & Agility
items.desc: Measure standing vertical reach, approach spike jump & block touch, lateral court speed, and footwork explosiveness.

items.title: Fundamental Ball Control
items.subtitle: Passing, Setting & Serving
items.desc: Evaluate first-pass stability & serve-receive accuracy, clean overhead setting precision, and consistent targeted serving over the net.

items.title: Position-Specific & Game IQ
items.subtitle: OH · MB · OP · S · L
items.desc: Assess live-play execution by registered position (OH, MB, OP, S, L) — pass–set–attack timing, net blocking, and back-row defense/coverage.

items.title: Discipline & Team Spirit
items.subtitle: Attitude & Coachability
items.desc: Punctuality, active listening to the Head Coach, positive communication on court, and supportive energy with teammates.

cta.title: Try-Out sessions open when 5+ athletes register
cta.scheduleSummary: 18:00–19:00 Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat & 13:30–14:30 Sunday at 155 Truong Chinh, Thanh Xuan
cta.desc: Submit your full athlete profile on the official DVA Registration page so our Coaching Staff can review your application and send your Try-Out invitation email.
